title: Secret's of the Stone
description: This story is yours to uncover in the stone, explore a new dimensions, craft new help, and reveal what lies in secret. (Exploratory dungeonlike + story)
body:
**_JEI & Baubles mods are required! (Also note: This mod is in alpha stages!)_**

**--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------**

![Title Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15620d71c108d21a568f9f898f729bdc7539841c.png)

This is as I'd like to call it: a exploratory dungeonlike mod, with story~

Long ago the Ancient Builders once flourished in grand cities and great prosperity. One day long ago they vanished leaving only remnants of their past and you to explore this vast world.

You spawn with a guidebook to help you along your journey! As well as an all new advancement tab.

In a dimension of Solitude you will find a new resource known as Ayre, craft all new weapons, tools and armor along with much more to come. In ancient text's you will gain the newfound knowledge of the Poison, Frost, Stoned, and Brutality enchants! Along your journey you will fine four key structures that will be the "key" to crafting something... Not only that but new food too, like the Plurple Fruit, Baked Plurple, Cooked Plurple from the Plurple Plant. This mod also add's different recipes that should be in vanilla like wool giving you string since you can make wool with string. Even craftable chainmail, and rotten flesh being useful?

**---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------**

This mod only supports 1.21.1 and 1.21.8 as of right now. (1.21.1 for wide range of mod compatibility and 1.21.8 for all the people who want spears, copper armor and things alike while playing.)

Baubles! A great thing to help on your journey, wear it! Dont wear it! Or throw it away because you dont care! WOW!

Example:

![Bauble Rune](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/becf9b31405f9b2e01d634b858108600d04e9828.png)

Check the images tab for more and greater pics!

**---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------**

Also anyone who wants to use this mod in a modpack, feel free to do so! Just don't take credit.

**---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------**
